177	// RunAggregate reads line-delimited JSON records from r and writes closed
178	// fixed window results, one JSON object per line, to out. windowMillis must
179	// be a positive signed 64-bit integer. Windows are fixed-length, start at
180	// time zero and use a left-closed right-open interval. Closure is driven
181	// solely by input watermarks: a window whose end is less than or equal to the
182	// current watermark is emitted once, ordered by end ascending and then by key
183	// in UTF-8 byte order. Late events (event time below the current watermark)
184	// are reported on lateLog with their physical line number and skipped. Every
185	// output must land in full: a window result is its complete JSON object plus
186	// trailing newline and a late-event notice is its complete single line. If
187	// the corresponding writer returns an error after accepting zero bytes or
188	// only a prefix, or accepts too few bytes with no error, the run fails at
189	// once with *OutputError naming the triggering physical input line:
190	// window-result failures identify the key and window [start,end), and
191	// late-notice failures identify the skipped event time and the watermark
192	// used; a nil-error short write is io.ErrShortWrite and errors.Is exposes
193	// the writer's original error. After such a failure no further records are
194	// processed, the failed content is neither rewritten nor resent, and
195	// still-open windows produce no further results; content already accepted
196	// by the writers stays in place, including fully written earlier results.
197	// Fatal record problems return *InputError; results already written to out
198	// stay written, and open windows are not flushed at end of input. An event
199	// key that would lose characters when decoded -- invalid UTF-8 bytes, or a
200	// \u escape whose surrogate half is unpaired or mispaired -- is such a fatal
201	// problem: it is never repaired to U+FFFD and counted, so distinct damaged
202	// keys can never merge or collide with a key that is genuinely U+FFFD. The
203	// check runs before the late-event check, so a damaged key is fatal even
204	// below the current watermark.
205	//
206	// A read failure is distinct from reaching the end of input. Only a reader
207	// returning the bare io.EOF sentinel is a clean end, where a final record that
208	// arrived without a trailing newline is still processed (and a damaged one is
209	// an *InputError carrying its physical line number). A wrapped io.EOF or a
210	// combined error whose chain merely contains io.EOF is still a read failure.
211	// When r returns any error other than the bare io.EOF after delivering bytes,
212	// only records whose newline was already received are processed, in order,
213	// including records returned by the same Read that carried the error; the
214	// remaining unterminated bytes never become an event, watermark or idle
215	// declaration and can produce no late notice or window result, and the
216	// reader's own error is then returned unchanged so errors.Is exposes it. A
217	// record or output failure on one of those complete lines is reported
218	// instead of the read error discovered afterwards.
219	//
220	// This is the legacy single-watermark mode: records carry no partition field
221	// and any extra fields are ignored. Use RunAggregatePartitioned to merge
222	// several independent input sources of the same stream, or
223	// RunAggregateSliding to emit overlapping windows at a shorter interval.
224	func RunAggregate(r io.Reader, windowMillis int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error {
225		return RunAggregatePartitionedSliding(r, windowMillis, windowMillis, 0, out, lateLog)
226	}
227	
228	// RunAggregateSliding is RunAggregate with overlapping sliding windows. The
229	// window length is windowMillis and consecutive window starts are slideMillis
230	// apart, beginning at time zero: 0, slideMillis, 2*slideMillis, ... Each
231	// window is left-closed right-open and no window with a negative start is
232	// created. slideMillis must be a positive signed 64-bit integer no greater
233	// than windowMillis and does not have to divide it; slideMillis equal to
234	// windowMillis is exactly RunAggregate's fixed-window behavior. A valid event
235	// is counted once in every window that contains its event time, adding to
236	// that window's per-key count and the full value to its sum. Everything else
237	// (watermark-only closure, ordering, late reporting, overflow handling and
238	// end-of-input behavior) is identical to RunAggregate.
239	func RunAggregateSliding(r io.Reader, windowMillis, slideMillis int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error {
240		return RunAggregatePartitionedSliding(r, windowMillis, slideMillis, 0, out, lateLog)
241	}
242	
243	// RunAggregatePartitioned is RunAggregatePartitionedSliding with slideMillis
244	// equal to windowMillis (non-overlapping fixed windows).
245	func RunAggregatePartitioned(r io.Reader, windowMillis, partitions int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error {
246		return RunAggregatePartitionedSliding(r, windowMillis, windowMillis, partitions, out, lateLog)
247	}
248	
249	// RunAggregatePartitionedSliding combines sliding windows (see
250	// RunAggregateSliding) with partitioned inputs: events from different
251	// partitions merge into one count and sum per key and window, and both the
252	// late-event check and window closure use the effective (minimum) watermark.
253	// windowMillis and slideMillis are validated exactly as in
254	// RunAggregateSliding. partitions selects the input mode:
255	//
256	//   - partitions == 0: legacy single-watermark mode. Records do not carry a
257	//     partition field; any extra fields are ignored.
258	//
259	//   - partitions > 0: partitioned mode, merging partitions independent input
260	//     sources of the same stream. Every event and watermark record must carry
261	//     an integer "partition" in [0,partitions). Each partition advances its
262	//     own watermark; no effective watermark exists until every partition has
263	//     reported at least once, afterwards the effective watermark is the
264	//     minimum of the per-partition values. Window closure and late-event
265	//     checks use this minimum, so one partition's larger watermark can never
266	//     close a window or drop an event ahead of the others. A partition
267	//     watermark may repeat or jump forward but never move backwards.
268	//
269	//     A partition may be declared idle with
270	//     {"type":"idle","partition":p}. An idle partition stops contributing to
271	//     the effective watermark: non-idle partitions that have not reported a
272	//     watermark yet still keep the effective watermark unknown, while a
273	//     partition that never reported may itself be declared idle. When every
274	//     remaining (non-idle) partition has reported, the effective watermark is
275	//     their minimum and the idle record itself can close windows. If all
276	//     partitions are idle, the last produced effective watermark is retained;
277	//     when none was ever produced it stays unknown. Idleness is declared by
278	//     the input only, never inferred from time; a repeated idle declaration
279	//     is a no-op. The next watermark record for that partition resumes it:
280	//     its time must be at least both the partition's previous watermark and
281	//     the current effective watermark. An event for an idle partition is
282	//     fatal; it never resumes implicitly.
283	//
284	// partitions < 0 is an error. Windows, ordering, late-event reporting,
285	// overflow checks and end-of-input behavior are otherwise identical to
286	// RunAggregateSliding.
287	func RunAggregatePartitionedSliding(r io.Reader, windowMillis, slideMillis, partitions int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error {
288		if err := ValidateAggregateParams(windowMillis, slideMillis, partitions); err != nil {
289			return err
290		}
291		s := &aggregateState{
292			windowMillis:  windowMillis,
293			slideMillis:   slideMillis,
294			windows:       make(map[windowID]*windowState),
295			out:           out,
296			lateLog:       lateLog,
297			partitions:    partitions,
298			partWatermark: make(map[int64]*int64),
299			idle:          make(map[int64]bool),
300			// Every partition starts out active and unreported; in legacy mode
301			// (partitions == 0) the counter stays zero and is never consulted.
302			unreportedActive: partitions,
303		}
304	
305		// Read records with a line collector that keeps a read failure distinct
306		// from end of input: only newline-terminated lines (plus, at a clean EOF,
307		// one unterminated final line) ever become records.
308		lineNo := 0
309		err := readAggregateLines(r, func(line string, no int) error {
310			lineNo = no
311			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
312				return nil
313			}
314			return s.processLine(line, lineNo)
315		})
316		return err
317	}
318	
319	// maxAggregateLineBytes caps the size of a single physical input line, matching
320	// the scanner buffer limit this used to run with. A line this long is fatal
321	// before its record is parsed.
322	const maxAggregateLineBytes = 1024 * 1024 * 1024
323	
324	// errAggregateLineTooLong reports a physical input line that never ends within
325	// maxAggregateLineBytes.
326	var errAggregateLineTooLong = errors.New("aggregate input line longer than 1 GiB")
327	
328	// errAggregateBadReadCount reports an io.Reader that handed back a byte count
329	// outside the destination buffer, violating the io.Reader contract.
330	var errAggregateBadReadCount = errors.New("aggregate reader returned an impossible byte count")
331	
332	// readAggregateLines feeds newline-delimited physical lines from r to handle,
333	// counting every line (a bare "\n" is a blank line too) and stripping a single
334	// trailing '\r' so CRLF input works as before. Clean end of input and a
335	// non-EOF read failure are handled differently: only the bare io.EOF
336	// sentinel is a clean end, and then a final line missing its newline is still
337	// delivered, exactly like every other final record; a wrapped io.EOF or a
338	// combined error whose chain contains io.EOF is a failure, not an end. After
339	// any error other than the bare io.EOF only lines whose newline was already
340	// received (including those delivered by the same Read that carried the
341	// error) are handled, in order, and then the reader's original error is
342	// returned. The unterminated tail never reaches handle, so a read failure
343	// mid-record can neither be misreported as an input error nor produce
344	// events, watermarks, idle declarations, late notices or window results. A
345	// non-nil error from handle stops reading immediately and replaces the read
346	// error, so an earlier record or output failure is not overwritten by a
347	// failure the reader only reports later.
348	func readAggregateLines(r io.Reader, handle func(line string, lineNo int) error) error {
349		// buf[start:end] is the undelivered tail; buf[:start] is space freed by
350		// already delivered lines. The buffer is compacted and grown like
351		// bufio.Scanner's, so a long unterminated line is bounded by
352		// maxAggregateLineBytes instead of growing without limit.
353		//
354		// searchFrom is the earliest absolute index not yet inspected for a '\n':
355		// every byte before it has either been delivered or searched already. A
356		// Read can only introduce a newline in the bytes it just appended, so the
357		// pending tail of a long line is never rescanned; scanning, compaction and
358		// growth together stay linear in the cumulative byte count even when each
359		// Read brings a single byte. searchFrom >= start always holds, and
360		// compaction/growth shift every absolute index by the same start they do.
361		buf := make([]byte, 64*1024)
362		start, end := 0, 0
363		searchFrom := 0
364		lineNo := 0
365		emptyReads := 0
366		deliver := func(b []byte) error {
367			lineNo++
368			line := strings.TrimSuffix(string(b), "\r")
369			return handle(line, lineNo)
370		}
371		for {
372			// Move the pending tail to the front when its freed prefix is large
373			// enough or when the whole buffer is pending.
374			if start > 0 && (end == len(buf) || start > len(buf)/2) {
375				copy(buf, buf[start:end])
376				end -= start
377				searchFrom -= start
378				if searchFrom < 0 {
379					searchFrom = 0
380				}
381				start = 0
382			}
383			if end == len(buf) {
384				// No newline fit before the end: the physical line is too long.
385				if len(buf) >= maxAggregateLineBytes {
386					return errAggregateLineTooLong
387				}
388				newLen := len(buf) * 2
389				if newLen > maxAggregateLineBytes || newLen < len(buf) {
390					newLen = maxAggregateLineBytes
391				}
392				grown := make([]byte, newLen)
393				copy(grown, buf[start:end])
394				buf = grown
395				end -= start
396				searchFrom -= start
397				if searchFrom < 0 {
398					searchFrom = 0
399				}
400				start = 0
401			}
402			n, readErr := r.Read(buf[end:])
403			if n < 0 || n > len(buf)-end {
404				// A Reader must never report a byte count outside the buffer.
405				return errAggregateBadReadCount
406			}
407			end += n
408			// Only this Read's newly appended bytes can still hold an unseen
409			// newline; search from searchFrom rather than from start, so a long
410			// line delivered a few bytes at a time costs one scan of each byte
411			// instead of one scan per Read over the whole accumulated tail.
412			for searchFrom < end {
413				i := bytes.IndexByte(buf[searchFrom:end], '\n')
414				if i < 0 {
415					break
416				}
417				idx := searchFrom + i
418				if err := deliver(buf[start:idx]); err != nil {
419					return err
420				}
421				start = idx + 1
422				searchFrom = start
423			}
424			searchFrom = end
425			if readErr != nil {
426				if readErr == io.EOF {
427					// Clean end of input: a trailing line without a newline is a
428					// complete final record; an empty tail (input ending exactly
429					// on '\n') is nothing, not an extra blank line. Only the
430					// bare io.EOF sentinel counts -- a wrapped EOF or a combined
431					// error whose chain contains io.EOF is a read failure, never
432					// a clean end.
433					if end > start {
434						if err := deliver(buf[start:end]); err != nil {
435							return err
436						}
437					}
438					return nil
439				}
440				// Any other failure means the stream stopped mid-record: the
441				// still-unterminated bytes are not a record. Surface the original
442				// error unchanged so errors.Is keeps working for callers.
443				return readErr
444			}
445			if n == 0 {
446				// No data and no error: refuse to spin forever on a broken Reader.
447				emptyReads++
448				if emptyReads > 100 {
449					return io.ErrNoProgress
450				}
451			} else {
452				emptyReads = 0
453			}
454		}
455	}

457	type aggregateState struct {
458		windowMillis int64
459		slideMillis  int64 // distance between consecutive window starts; equals windowMillis for fixed windows
460		windows      map[windowID]*windowState
461		out          io.Writer
462		lateLog      io.Writer
463	
464		partitions    int64 // 0 = legacy single-watermark mode
465		watermark     *int64
466		partWatermark map[int64]*int64 // partition -> last watermark; partitioned mode only
467		idle          map[int64]bool   // partitions declared idle in the input; partitioned mode only
468		// unreportedActive counts the partitions that are neither idle nor have
469		// reported a watermark yet; partitioned mode only. While it is positive
470		// no effective watermark exists, so the waiting check is a single look at
471		// this counter instead of a rescan of every partition's reporting state.
472		// It never increases: a partition leaves the count by reporting or by
473		// being declared idle, and resuming from idle always happens through a
474		// watermark record, which reports at the same moment.
475		unreportedActive int64
476	}

478	func (s *aggregateState) processLine(line string, lineNo int) error {
479		var obj map[string]json.RawMessage
480		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &obj); err != nil {
481			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: "invalid JSON record: " + err.Error()}
482		}
483	
484		typeRaw, ok := obj["type"]
485		if !ok {
486			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: `missing required string field "type"`}
487		}
488		recordType, err := decodeString(typeRaw, "type")
489		if err != nil {
490			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: err.Error()}
491		}
492	
493		switch recordType {
494		case "event":
495			return s.processEvent(obj, lineNo)
496		case "watermark":
497			return s.processWatermark(obj, lineNo)
498		case "idle":
499			// Only partitioned mode knows idle declarations; legacy
500			// single-watermark mode treats it as any unknown record type.
501			if s.partitions == 0 {
502				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown record type %q", recordType)}
503			}
504			return s.processIdle(obj, lineNo)
505		default:
506			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown record type %q", recordType)}
507		}
508	}

510	// floorDiv returns math.Floor(a/b) for b > 0; Go's / truncates toward zero,
511	// so negative numerators need explicit adjustment.
512	func floorDiv(a, b int64) int64 {
513		q := a / b
514		if a%b != 0 && a < 0 {
515			q--
516		}
517		return q
518	}
519	
520	// containingWindows describes every window that contains one event time, in
521	// one derivation shared by the normal counting path and the window-end
522	// overflow precheck: how many windows there are, where each starts, and which
523	// (if any) is the earliest whose end leaves the signed 64-bit range. Windows
524	// start at 0, slide, 2*slide, ... and none with a negative start is created,
525	// so the first index is clamped to zero. The last index is
526	// eventTime/slide, so an event at a window end is outside that window.
527	type containingWindows struct {
528		count     int64 // how many windows contain the event time
529		lastStart int64 // start of the last (highest) containing window
530		slide     int64 // distance between consecutive window starts
531		// firstOverflow is the start of the earliest containing window whose end
532		// (start + windowMillis) leaves the signed 64-bit range, or -1 when every
533		// containing window fits. Containing starts are an ascending arithmetic
534		// sequence with step slide, so overflow (if any) is a suffix and this is
535		// its first member.
536		firstOverflow int64
537	}
538	
539	// containingWindows derives the containing-window range for eventTime.
540	func (s *aggregateState) containingWindows(eventTime int64) containingWindows {
541		last := eventTime / s.slideMillis
542		first := floorDiv(eventTime-s.windowMillis, s.slideMillis) + 1
543		if first < 0 {
544			first = 0
545		}
546		w := containingWindows{
547			count:         last - first + 1,
548			lastStart:     eventTime - eventTime%s.slideMillis,
549			slide:         s.slideMillis,
550			firstOverflow: -1,
551		}
552		lowest := w.start(w.count - 1) // earliest containing start; never negative
553		maxSafeStart := int64(math.MaxInt64 - s.windowMillis)
554		switch {
555		case lowest > maxSafeStart:
556			w.firstOverflow = lowest
557		default:
558			safe := (maxSafeStart-lowest)/s.slideMillis + 1 // containing starts that fit
559			if safe < w.count {
560				// Reach back from lastStart, which is at most eventTime, so the
561				// subtraction cannot leave the signed 64-bit range.
562				w.firstOverflow = w.start(w.count - 1 - safe)
563			}
564		}
565		return w
566	}
567	
568	// start returns the start of the containing window reached back by offset
569	// indices from the last one (offset 0 = last window).
570	func (w containingWindows) start(offset int64) int64 {
571		return w.lastStart - offset*w.slide
572	}

574	// eventRecord is one input event whose record content has already been
575	// interpreted and validated independently of aggregate state: key, time,
576	// value and (in partitioned mode) partition are final. Nothing about idle
577	// partitions, watermarks or windows has been inspected yet, so producing one
578	// never mutates -- or even reads -- window state.
579	type eventRecord struct {
580		key       string
581		time      int64
582		value     int64
583		partition int64 // partitioned mode only; always 0 in legacy mode
584	}
585	
586	// parseEventRecord is the interpretation half of event intake. It reads and
587	// checks the record's own fields and never consults aggregate state, so field
588	// legality is fully decided before any idle, late or window rule runs. Fields
589	// are validated in the order they have always been rejected: key, then time,
590	// then value, then partition. The key is decoded strictly: an empty key,
591	// invalid UTF-8 bytes and an unpaired or mispaired surrogate half are record
592	// errors, never content repaired to U+FFFD that could merge keys. In legacy
593	// mode (partitioned == false) extra fields -- including any stray partition
594	// field -- stay ignored and partition is reported as zero.
595	func parseEventRecord(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, partitioned bool, partitionCount int64, lineNo int) (eventRecord, error) {
596		key, err := requiredKey(obj, lineNo)
597		if err != nil {
598			return eventRecord{}, err
599		}
600		if key == "" {
601			return eventRecord{}, &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: `field "key" must be a non-empty string`}
602		}
603		eventTime, err := requiredNonNegInt64(obj, "time", lineNo)
604		if err != nil {
605			return eventRecord{}, err
606		}
607		value, err := requiredInt64(obj, "value", lineNo)
608		if err != nil {
609			return eventRecord{}, err
610		}
611		var partition int64
612		if partitioned {
613			partition, err = requiredPartitionField(obj, partitionCount, lineNo)
614			if err != nil {
615				return eventRecord{}, err
616			}
617		}
618		return eventRecord{
619			key:       key,
620			time:      eventTime,
621			value:     value,
622			partition: partition,
623		}, nil
624	}
625	
626	func (s *aggregateState) processEvent(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) error {
627		// Stage 1: interpret and validate the record's own content without
628		// touching aggregate state.
629		ev, err := parseEventRecord(obj, s.partitions > 0, s.partitions, lineNo)
630		if err != nil {
631			return err
632		}
633		// Stage 2: apply the validated event to aggregate state.
634		return s.acceptEvent(ev, lineNo)
635	}
636	
637	// acceptEvent is the state half of event intake: it applies one record that
638	// parseEventRecord has already fully validated, in the same order as before
639	// the split -- idle partition first, then the global-watermark late rule, and
640	// only afterwards the window counts. It never re-reads or re-validates record
641	// fields, so a field problem can never be downgraded to an idle failure or a
642	// late notice here. Partitioned mode judges lateness against the overall
643	// effective watermark; an event on an idle partition stays fatal and never
644	// resumes the partition implicitly. A strictly late event is skipped with the
645	// existing notice; an event time equal to the watermark still enters its
646	// windows.
647	func (s *aggregateState) acceptEvent(ev eventRecord, lineNo int) error {
648		if s.partitions > 0 && s.idle[ev.partition] {
649			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("event for idle partition %d is not allowed; send a watermark to resume it first", ev.partition)}
650		}
651	
652		if s.watermark != nil && ev.time < *s.watermark {
653			notice := fmt.Sprintf("line %d: late event time=%d below current watermark %d, skipped\n", lineNo, ev.time, *s.watermark)
654			if err := writeFull(s.lateLog, []byte(notice)); err != nil {
655				return &OutputError{
656					Line:   lineNo,
657					Kind:   "late-event notice",
658					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("event time %d below current watermark %d", ev.time, *s.watermark),
659					Err:    err,
660				}
661			}
662			return nil
663		}
664	
665		return s.applyEventToWindows(ev, lineNo)
666	}
667	
668	// applyEventToWindows counts one accepted event in every window that contains
669	// its event time, one count and the full value per window. It only mutates
670	// window state; the caller has already settled field validity, idleness and
671	// lateness. The containing-window range is derived once and shared by the
672	// window-end overflow precheck and the counting loop, so both judge the exact
673	// same set of windows. The precheck runs before any window is touched;
674	// per-window count and sum overflows then fail on this triggering event in
675	// ascending window-start order rather than at watermark closure.
676	func (s *aggregateState) applyEventToWindows(ev eventRecord, lineNo int) error {
677		wins := s.containingWindows(ev.time)
678	
679		// A window whose end leaves the signed 64-bit range is fatal for the
680		// whole input line; check before updating any window state.
681		if wins.firstOverflow >= 0 {
682			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("window end overflow for key %q window starting at %d with length %d", ev.key, wins.firstOverflow, s.windowMillis)}
683		}
684	
685		// Add the event once to each containing window, in ascending start
686		// order. An overflow here stops processing immediately; already closed
687		// (and thus already written) windows are unaffected.
688		for i := wins.count - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
689			if err := s.addEventToWindow(ev, wins.start(i), lineNo); err != nil {
690				return err
691			}
692		}
693		return nil
694	}
695	
696	// addEventToWindow folds a single accepted event into one containing window,
697	// creating the window first if needed, enforcing the signed 64-bit count and
698	// cumulative-sum boundaries before the mutation. On failure the window keeps
699	// its previous count and sum and the error names the physical line, the key
700	// and this window's [start,end) interval.
701	func (s *aggregateState) addEventToWindow(ev eventRecord, start int64, lineNo int) error {
702		end := start + s.windowMillis
703		id := windowID{start: start, key: ev.key}
704		st := s.windows[id]
705		if st == nil {
706			st = &windowState{end: end}
707			s.windows[id] = st
708		}
709		if st.count == math.MaxInt64 {
710			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("event count overflow for key %q window [%d,%d)", ev.key, start, end)}
711		}
712		if ev.value > 0 && st.sum > math.MaxInt64-ev.value {
713			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("cumulative sum overflow for key %q window [%d,%d): %d + %d", ev.key, start, end, st.sum, ev.value)}
714		}
715		if ev.value < 0 && st.sum < math.MinInt64-ev.value {
716			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("cumulative sum overflow for key %q window [%d,%d): %d + %d", ev.key, start, end, st.sum, ev.value)}
717		}
718		st.count++
719		st.sum += ev.value
720		return nil
721	}
722	
723	// watermarkRecord is one input watermark whose record content has already been
724	// interpreted and validated independently of aggregate state: time and (in
725	// partitioned mode) partition are final. Nothing about a previous watermark,
726	// the effective minimum or an idle partition has been inspected yet, so
727	// producing one never mutates -- or even reads -- window or watermark state.
728	type watermarkRecord struct {
729		time      int64
730		partition int64 // partitioned mode only; always 0 in legacy mode
731	}
732	
733	// parseWatermarkRecord is the interpretation half of watermark intake. It
734	// reads and checks the record's own fields and never consults aggregate
735	// state, so field legality is fully decided before any single-watermark,
736	// backwards or idle-resume rule runs. Fields are validated in the order they
737	// have always been rejected, independent of their textual order in the JSON:
738	// time first, then partition. Time must be a non-negative signed 64-bit
739	// integer. In partitioned mode partition must be present and in
740	// [0,partitionCount); when both fields are bad the time problem is the one
741	// reported. In legacy mode (partitioned == false) extra fields -- including
742	// any stray partition field, whatever its value -- stay ignored and never
743	// reject the record; partition is reported as zero.
744	func parseWatermarkRecord(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, partitioned bool, partitionCount int64, lineNo int) (watermarkRecord, error) {
745		next, err := requiredNonNegInt64(obj, "time", lineNo)
746		if err != nil {
747			return watermarkRecord{}, err
748		}
749		var partition int64
750		if partitioned {
751			partition, err = requiredPartitionField(obj, partitionCount, lineNo)
752			if err != nil {
753				return watermarkRecord{}, err
754			}
755		}
756		return watermarkRecord{time: next, partition: partition}, nil
757	}
758	
759	func (s *aggregateState) processWatermark(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) error {
760		// Stage 1: interpret and validate the record's own content without
761		// touching aggregate state.
762		wm, err := parseWatermarkRecord(obj, s.partitions > 0, s.partitions, lineNo)
763		if err != nil {
764			return err
765		}
766		// Stage 2: decide whether the validated watermark may change state and,
767		// only once it may, record it and close windows.
768		return s.acceptWatermark(wm, lineNo)
769	}
770	
771	// acceptWatermark is the state half of watermark intake: it applies one record
772	// that parseWatermarkRecord has already fully validated. It never re-reads or
773	// re-validates record fields, so a field problem can never be downgraded to a
774	// backwards-watermark or resume failure here, and a rejected record returns
775	// before any state changes: the partition is not resumed early, no watermark
776	// advances and no window output is triggered. A legal watermark may repeat or
777	// jump forward; the single legacy watermark and each active partition's own
778	// watermark still never move backwards. An accepted watermark funnels through
779	// the same advance-and-close path as an idle declaration.
780	func (s *aggregateState) acceptWatermark(wm watermarkRecord, lineNo int) error {
781		if s.partitions == 0 {
782			if s.watermark != nil && wm.time < *s.watermark {
783				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("watermark moved backwards from %d to %d", *s.watermark, wm.time)}
784			}
785			s.watermark = &wm.time
786			return s.advanceWatermark(lineNo)
787		}
788		if err := s.checkPartitionWatermark(wm, lineNo); err != nil {
789			return err
790		}
791		s.applyPartitionWatermark(wm)
792		return s.advanceWatermark(lineNo)
793	}
794	
795	// checkPartitionWatermark decides, without mutating anything, whether one
796	// record-valid partitioned-mode watermark may change aggregate state, and
797	// returns the existing *InputError when it may not. Two situations are kept
798	// apart:
799	//
800	//   - The partition is active: its watermark may repeat or jump forward but
801	//     never move backwards relative to its own previous value.
802	//   - The partition is idle: the record resumes it, and its time must be at
803	//     least both the partition's own previous watermark and the current
804	//     effective (minimum) watermark; equality on either boundary resumes. When
805	//     both lower bounds are violated the partition's own previous watermark is
806	//     the one reported, checked first. A partition that idled before ever
807	//     reporting has no previous watermark, so only the effective bound
808	//     applies.
809	func (s *aggregateState) checkPartitionWatermark(wm watermarkRecord, lineNo int) error {
810		p, next := wm.partition, wm.time
811		if s.idle[p] {
812			if prev, ok := s.partWatermark[p]; ok && next < *prev {
813				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("resume watermark %d for partition %d is below its previous watermark %d", next, p, *prev)}
814			}
815			if s.watermark != nil && next < *s.watermark {
816				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("resume watermark %d for partition %d is below the current effective watermark %d", next, p, *s.watermark)}
817			}
818			return nil
819		}
820		if prev, ok := s.partWatermark[p]; ok && next < *prev {
821			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("watermark for partition %d moved backwards from %d to %d", p, *prev, next)}
822		}
823		return nil
824	}
825	
826	// applyPartitionWatermark records one partition watermark that
827	// checkPartitionWatermark has already accepted, keeping the bookkeeping apart
828	// from the decision: a resume removes the partition from the idle set, and the
829	// first report from an active partition decrements the count of partitions
830	// the effective watermark still waits for. A resume of a never-reported
831	// partition changes no counter -- that partition was already subtracted when
832	// it was declared idle -- and only after that is the partition's watermark
833	// value replaced.
834	func (s *aggregateState) applyPartitionWatermark(wm watermarkRecord) {
835		p, next := wm.partition, wm.time
836		resuming := s.idle[p]
837		if resuming {
838			delete(s.idle, p)
839		}
840		if _, reported := s.partWatermark[p]; !reported && !resuming {
841			s.unreportedActive--
842		}
843		s.partWatermark[p] = &next
844	}
845	
846	// processIdle declares a partition idle: it stops contributing to the
847	// effective watermark until its next watermark record. The declaration
848	// itself may advance the effective watermark and close windows.
849	func (s *aggregateState) processIdle(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) error {
850		p, err := s.requiredPartition(obj, lineNo)
851		if err != nil {
852			return err
853		}
854		if s.idle[p] {
855			// A repeated idle declaration is a no-op: the partition already
856			// stopped contributing, so neither the effective watermark nor the
857			// set of closable windows can change.
858			return nil
859		}
860		s.idle[p] = true
861		if _, reported := s.partWatermark[p]; !reported {
862			// An unreported partition that goes idle stops being waited on: one
863			// fewer active partition the effective watermark still needs.
864			s.unreportedActive--
865		}
866		// With the partition excluded, the remaining non-idle partitions
867		// determine the effective watermark; the declaration itself can advance
868		// it and close windows, exactly like a watermark update.
869		return s.advanceWatermark(lineNo)
870	}
871	
872	// advanceWatermark applies a partition state change -- a partition watermark
873	// update or an idle declaration -- and closes every window the resulting
874	// watermark allows. Both triggers funnel through here so they follow the
875	// same rules: in partitioned mode the effective watermark is recomputed from
876	// the current partition state (an active partition that has not reported yet
877	// keeps it unknown, and when every partition is idle the last produced value
878	// is retained instead of clearing); in legacy single-watermark mode the
879	// single watermark is used as is. While no effective watermark exists no
880	// window closes; otherwise closeWindows emits every window whose end is less
881	// than or equal to it.
882	func (s *aggregateState) advanceWatermark(lineNo int) error {
883		if s.partitions > 0 {
884			if next := s.effectiveWatermark(); next != nil {
885				s.watermark = next
886			}
887		}
888		if s.watermark == nil {
889			return nil
890		}
891		return s.closeWindows(*s.watermark, lineNo)
892	}
893	
894	// effectiveWatermark returns the minimum watermark over the non-idle
895	// partitions once each of them has reported at least once, or nil
896	// otherwise. When every partition is idle, nil is returned so the caller
897	// keeps the last produced effective watermark. The waiting check itself is
898	// the unreportedActive counter, maintained incrementally as partitions
899	// report or go idle, so a watermark or idle record that arrives while
900	// partitions are still silent costs one comparison rather than a rescan of
901	// every partition's reporting state; only once the counter reaches zero --
902	// every active partition has reported -- is the minimum computed by the
903	// scan below, exactly as before.
904	func (s *aggregateState) effectiveWatermark() *int64 {
905		active := s.partitions - int64(len(s.idle))
906		if active <= 0 || s.unreportedActive > 0 {
907			return nil
908		}
909		var min int64
910		first := true
911		for p := int64(0); p < s.partitions; p++ {
912			if s.idle[p] {
913				continue
914			}
915			w, ok := s.partWatermark[p]
916			if !ok {
917				return nil
918			}
919			if first || *w < min {
920				min = *w
921				first = false
922			}
923		}
924		return &min
925	}

927	// requiredPartition returns the record's partition index. In legacy mode it
928	// returns 0 without inspecting the record, so extra fields stay ignored. In
929	// partitioned mode the actual reading and range checking lives in the shared
930	// free function used by event interpretation as well.
931	func (s *aggregateState) requiredPartition(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) (int64, error) {
932		if s.partitions == 0 {
933			return 0, nil
934		}
935		return requiredPartitionField(obj, s.partitions, lineNo)
936	}

938	// requiredPartitionField reads and range-checks a partitioned-mode record's
939	// "partition" field. It is pure record interpretation: the partition count is
940	// passed in rather than read from aggregate state, so both the event intake
941	// split (parseEventRecord) and the watermark/idle paths validate the field by
942	// the exact same rule without touching window state.
943	func requiredPartitionField(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, partitionCount int64, lineNo int) (int64, error) {
944		p, err := requiredInt64(obj, "partition", lineNo)
945		if err != nil {
946			return 0, err
947		}
948		if p < 0 || p >= partitionCount {
949			return 0, &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("field %q must be an integer in range [0,%d), got %d", "partition", partitionCount, p)}
950		}
951		return p, nil
952	}
953	
954	func (s *aggregateState) closeWindows(watermark int64, lineNo int) error {
955		type pending struct {
956			id windowID
957			st *windowState
958		}
959		var ready []pending
960		for id, st := range s.windows {
961			if st.end <= watermark {
962				ready = append(ready, pending{id: id, st: st})
963			}
964		}
965		sort.Slice(ready, func(i, j int) bool {
966			if ready[i].st.end != ready[j].st.end {
967				return ready[i].st.end < ready[j].st.end
968			}
969			return ready[i].id.key < ready[j].id.key
970		})
971		for _, p := range ready {
972			encoded, err := json.Marshal(AggregateResult{
973				Key:   p.id.key,
974				Start: p.id.start,
975				End:   p.st.end,
976				Count: p.st.count,
977				Sum:   p.st.sum,
978			})
979			if err != nil {
980				return err
981			}
982			line := append(encoded, '\n')
983			if err := writeFull(s.out, line); err != nil {
984				// Stop immediately: the writer may hold zero bytes or only a
985				// prefix of this record, but a truncated record is not a fully
986				// output one, so the window stays open in the map. Do not retry
987				// or resend it and do not emit the remaining ready windows;
988				// content already accepted by the writer stays.
989				return &OutputError{
990					Line:   lineNo,
991					Kind:   "window result",
992					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("key %q window [%d,%d)", p.id.key, p.id.start, p.st.end),
993					Err:    err,
994				}
995			}
996			delete(s.windows, p.id)
997		}
998		return nil
999	}

1001	func requiredString(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, field string, lineNo int) (string, error) {
1002		raw, ok := obj[field]

1009		}
1010		return value, nil

1012	
1013	// requiredKey returns the event key decoded strictly. encoding/json silently
1014	// repairs damaged string content with U+FFFD -- invalid UTF-8 bytes and \u
1015	// escapes whose surrogate halves are unpaired or mispaired -- which would
1016	// merge distinct damaged keys into one and collide with a key that is
1017	// genuinely U+FFFD. Such damage is a fatal input error here instead, so a
1018	// corrupt key never changes any window's count or sum. Valid characters
1019	// (including a directly encoded or escaped U+FFFD and supplementary-plane
1020	// characters, whether literal or written as a surrogate pair) decode to
1021	// their exact value and aggregate as before.
1022	func requiredKey(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) (string, error) {
1023		raw, ok := obj["key"]
1024		if !ok {
1025			return "", &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: `missing required string field "key"`}
1026		}
1027		key, err := decodeKeyString(raw)
1028		if err != nil {
1029			return "", &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: err.Error()}
1030		}
1031		return key, nil

1034	// decodeKeyString decodes the event key's JSON string without the lossy
1035	// repairs encoding/json applies: invalid UTF-8 byte sequences and \u escapes
1036	// with unpaired or mispaired surrogate halves are errors instead of becoming
1037	// U+FFFD. The record already parsed as JSON, so the string's escape syntax
1038	// is valid; only its character content is checked here. An escaped backslash
1039	// is decoded first, so "\\uD800" stays the literal text D800 and is not
1040	// mistaken for an unpaired surrogate.
1041	func decodeKeyString(raw json.RawMessage) (string, error) {
1042		trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
1043		if len(trimmed) < 2 || trimmed[0] != '"' || trimmed[len(trimmed)-1] != '"' {
1044			return "", fmt.Errorf("field %q must be a JSON string, got %s", "key", string(trimmed))
1045		}
1046		s := string(trimmed[1 : len(trimmed)-1])
1047		var sb strings.Builder
1048		sb.Grow(len(s))

1050			c := s[i]
1051			switch {
1052			case c == '\\':
1053				if i+1 >= len(s) {
1054					return "", fmt.Errorf("field %q ends in an incomplete escape", "key")
1055				}
1056				switch s[i+1] {
1057				case '"', '\\', '/':
1058					sb.WriteByte(s[i+1])
1059					i += 2
1060				case 'b':
1061					sb.WriteByte('\b')
1062					i += 2
1063				case 'f':
1064					sb.WriteByte('\f')
1065					i += 2
1066				case 'n':
1067					sb.WriteByte('\n')
1068					i += 2
1069				case 'r':
1070					sb.WriteByte('\r')
1071					i += 2
1072				case 't':
1073					sb.WriteByte('\t')
1074					i += 2
1075				case 'u':
1076					r, next, err := decodeUnicodeEscape(s, i)
1077					if err != nil {

1079					}
1080					sb.WriteRune(r)
1081					i = next

1084				}
1085			case c < utf8.RuneSelf:

1090				if r == utf8.RuneError && size == 1 {
1091					return "", fmt.Errorf("field %q contains invalid UTF-8 bytes in its character encoding", "key")
1092				}

1100	// decodeUnicodeEscape decodes the \uXXXX escape at s[i] (where s[i] == '\\'
1101	// and s[i+1] == 'u'), returning the decoded rune and the index just past the
1102	// escape. A high surrogate must be immediately followed by a \u escape
1103	// carrying the matching low surrogate; the pair combines into one
1104	// supplementary-plane rune. An unpaired or mispaired half is an error rather
1105	// than U+FFFD.
1106	func decodeUnicodeEscape(s string, i int) (rune, int, error) {
1107		r, next, err := parseHexEscape(s, i)
1108		if err != nil {
1109			return 0, 0, err
1110		}
1111		switch {
1112		case r >= 0xD800 && r <= 0xDBFF:
1113			if next+1 >= len(s) || s[next] != '\\' || s[next+1] != 'u' {
1114				return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q has an unpaired high surrogate in a Unicode escape", "key")
1115			}
1116			lo, after, err := parseHexEscape(s, next)
1117			if err != nil {
1118				return 0, 0, err
1119			}
1120			if lo < 0xDC00 || lo > 0xDFFF {
1121				return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q has a high surrogate not followed by a low surrogate in a Unicode escape", "key")
1122			}
1123			return 0x10000 + (r-0xD800)<<10 + (lo - 0xDC00), after, nil
1124		case r >= 0xDC00 && r <= 0xDFFF:
1125			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q has an unpaired low surrogate in a Unicode escape", "key")
1126		}
1127		return r, next, nil
1128	}
1129	
1130	// parseHexEscape reads the four hex digits of the \uXXXX escape at s[i]
1131	// (where s[i] == '\\' and s[i+1] == 'u') and returns their value and the
1132	// index just past them.
1133	func parseHexEscape(s string, i int) (rune, int, error) {
1134		if i+6 > len(s) {
1135			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q has a truncated Unicode escape", "key")
1136		}
1137		var v rune
1138		for _, c := range s[i+2 : i+6] {
1139			v <<= 4
1140			switch {
1141			case c >= '0' && c <= '9':
1142				v += c - '0'
1143			case c >= 'a' && c <= 'f':
1144				v += c - 'a' + 10
1145			case c >= 'A' && c <= 'F':
1146				v += c - 'A' + 10
1147			default:
1148				return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q has a non-hex digit in a Unicode escape", "key")
1149			}
1150		}
1151		return v, i + 6, nil
1152	}

1	# 验证者与边缘节点机群管理平台
2	
3	## 用途
4	
5	节点注册与身份、心跳与遥测、离线同步、配置分发与滚动升级、罚没与健康规则告警、远程运维记录。
6	
7	本仓库是可持续演进的自托管 Go 应用。领域核心位于 `edgefleet/`，命令入口位于 `cmd/edgefleet/`。
8	
9	```bash
10	go run ./cmd/edgefleet demo
11	go run ./cmd/edgefleet version
12	go run ./cmd/edgefleet help
13	printf '%s\n' \
14	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1200,"value":5}' \
15	  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000}' \
16	  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000
17	go test ./...
18	```
19	
20	`aggregate` 从标准输入读取逐行 JSON 事件与水位线记录，按事件时间汇总固定长度窗口（左闭右开，从时间零开始），只在输入水位线推进时输出 end ≤ 水位线的窗口；完全离线，不使用当前时间。可选的 `--slide-ms <milliseconds>` 给出相邻窗口起点的间隔（正数、不大于 `--window-ms`、不要求整除），起点依次为 0、一个间隔、两个间隔，事件会计入所有包含其事件时间的重叠窗口；省略该参数或令其等于窗口长度时与固定窗口行为完全一致。`--partitions <count>` 可合并同一输入流的多个分区：各分区水位线独立推进，全部到齐后整体水位线取各分区最小值，分区字段不进入输出，迟到判断与窗口关闭均使用该整体水位线。分区模式下可用 `{"type":"idle","partition":N}` 显式声明某分区暂时无数据，休眠只由输入声明、不依据时间推断；休眠分区退出整体水位线计算，待下一条不低于其旧水位线和当前整体水位线的水位线记录恢复。详见 `go run ./cmd/edgefleet help`。
21	
22	## 示例：滑动窗口、事件重复计数与迟到跳过
23	
24	下面是一个可直接离线运行的完整示例：窗口长度 1000 毫秒（`--window-ms 1000`）、滑动间隔 600 毫秒（`--slide-ms 600`），不使用分区，围绕单一水位线和同一个 key `sensor-a` 展开。所有时间均以毫秒计，`time` 为非负的 64 位有符号整数，`value` 为 64 位有符号整数。
25	
26	窗口起点从时间零开始、按滑动间隔 600 递增，即 0、600、1200、1800……每个窗口长度均为 1000，区间左闭右开：
27	
28	```
29	[0,1000)  [600,1600)  [1200,2200)  [1800,2800) ...
30	```
31	
32	一条事件会计入**所有**包含其事件时间的窗口（在每个窗口中各计一次数、各加一次完整的值），所以窗口重叠时同一事件会出现在多个结果行中；窗口仍然只在水位线推进时关闭。
33	
34	命令与完整的逐行 JSON 输入（共 7 行）：
35	
36	```bash
37	printf '%s\n' \
38	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":700,"value":2}' \
39	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1000,"value":3}' \
40	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000}' \
41	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":999,"value":9}' \
42	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1000,"value":4}' \
43	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1600}' \
44	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1700,"value":5}' \
45	  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --slide-ms 600
46	```
47	
48	终端中标准输出与标准错误按处理顺序交错出现（行尾注释标明各自属于哪个流），进程正常结束，退出码为 0：
49	
50	```
51	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":2}             # 标准输出（第 3 行水位线触发）
52	line 4: late event time=999 below current watermark 1000, skipped    # 标准错误（第 4 行事件触发）
53	{"key":"sensor-a","start":600,"end":1600,"count":3,"sum":9}           # 标准输出（第 6 行水位线触发）
54	```
55	
56	即分开看时，标准输出恰好为两行：
57	
58	```json
59	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":2}
60	{"key":"sensor-a","start":600,"end":1600,"count":3,"sum":9}
61	```
62	
63	标准错误恰好为一行：
64	
65	```
66	line 4: late event time=999 below current watermark 1000, skipped
67	```
68	
69	逐行说明（行号即物理输入行号）：
70	
71	- 第 1 行：事件时间 700、值 2。因为 0 ≤ 700 < 1000 且 600 ≤ 700 < 1600，它**同时属于 `[0,1000)` 和 `[600,1600)` 两个窗口**，在两个窗口中各计一次 count、各加一次 2。这就是滑动窗口下同一事件会出现在多个结果中的原因。此时还没有任何水位线，没有输出。
72	- 第 2 行：事件时间 1000、值 3。区间左闭右开，时间恰好等于前一个窗口的右端点，所以 1000 **不属于 `[0,1000)`**；按起点 0、600、1200……排列，包含 1000 的窗口只有 `[600,1600)`（600 ≤ 1000 < 1600）——并不存在起点为 1000 的窗口，而下一个窗口 `[1200,2200)` 要到时间 1200 才开始，也不包含它。此时仍没有水位线，没有输出。
73	- 第 3 行：水位线推进到 1000。所有 end ≤ 1000 的窗口关闭，符合条件的只有 `[0,1000)`（end 恰好等于 1000，取等关闭）；其中只有第 1 行的事件，因此输出 count=1、sum=2。`[600,1600)` 的 end 为 1600，大于水位线，仍然继续等待，这就是标准输出的第一行。
74	- 第 4 行：事件时间 999、值 9。999 虽然仍落在尚未关闭的重叠窗口 `[600,1600)` 之内，但迟到判断先于入窗：999 严格低于当前水位线 1000，事件被**整体跳过**，不进入任何窗口，标准错误按物理行号报告迟到原因（见上面的标准错误行）。它的值 9 不会贡献给任何计数或求和。
75	- 第 5 行：事件时间 1000、值 4。时间**恰好等于当前水位线**，规则只拒绝严格低于水位线的事件，所以这条仍被正常接收；与第 2 行同理，它只进入 `[600,1600)` 一个窗口，没有输出。
76	- 第 6 行：水位线推进到 1600，关闭 `[600,1600)`（已关闭的 `[0,1000)` 不会重复输出，下一个窗口 `[1200,2200)` 的 end 为 2200，仍要等待）。这个窗口里是第 1、2、5 行的三条事件（时间 700/值 2、1000/值 3、1000/值 4），所以 count=3、sum=2+3+4=9；第 4 行被跳过的事件不在其中。这就是标准输出的第二行。
77	- 第 7 行：事件时间 1700、值 5。1700 不低于当前水位线 1600，是合法事件；按窗口排列，包含 1700 的窗口只有 `[1200,2200)`（1200 ≤ 1700 < 2200）——`[600,1600)` 的右端点 1600 已在它之前，而下一个窗口 `[1800,2800)` 的起点 1800 还未到，所以它只进入这一个窗口。随后输入正常结束，而 `[1200,2200)` 的 end 为 2200，大于当前水位线 1600；**结束输入不会补发任何仍未关闭的窗口**，所以这个窗口不产生任何输出，第 7 行的事件也不会出现在任何结果行中。第 4 行的迟到提示只是标准错误上的一条说明，并不是运行失败：整个进程退出码仍为 0。
78

130	## 示例：事件 key 的转义写法——什么情况下合并计数，什么情况下分成两个窗口
131	
132	前面的命令行示例都用 `sensor-a` 这类不含特殊字符的普通 key，读者很难判断两条字符串写法不同的记录究竟是合并计数，还是成为两个窗口结果。事件的 `key` 是一个 JSON 字符串，程序按 **JSON 解码之后的字符串** 分组，而不是按输入行里那串字面文本分组。读这类示例时要分清三层，三层出现的反斜杠数量不同：
133	
134	1. **你在命令行里写下、由 shell 单引号原样交出的文本**。本节命令一律用单引号 `'...'` 包住每条记录；单引号内不做任何转义处理，所以你看到几个反斜杠，程序就收到几个。
135	2. **程序实际读到的输入字节**。例如 key 位置写下 `a\nb` 时，这一行的字节就是 `a`、`\`、`n`、`b`，反斜杠是真实字节 0x5C，记录本身并没有真的换行，仍占一个物理输入行。
136	3. **JSON 解码之后参与分组的字符**。JSON 把 `\n` 解码成一个换行字符（0x0A），把 `\\` 解码成一个反斜杠字符（0x5C）。**窗口按这一层的字符串合并与排序**：两条记录是否同一个 key，只取决于这一层是否逐字符相同。
137	
138	### 成功示例：同一换行字符的两种写法合并，真正的"反斜杠＋n"单独汇总
139	
140	1000 毫秒固定窗口（省略 `--slide-ms`）、单水位线（不带分区）。三条事件的时间 100/200/300 都落在同一个窗口 `[0,1000)` 内，最后一条水位线 1000 关闭它。前两条记录用两种合法写法表示**同一个含换行字符的 key**（一种用 `\n`，另一种用 `\u000a`），第三条在同一位置写的是**反斜杠加字母 n 这两个普通字符**；三条事件的 value 分别取 2、3、7，便于直接复核。命令可直接离线运行，并用构建出的二进制观察程序自身退出码：
141	
142	```bash
143	go build -o /tmp/edgefleet ./cmd/edgefleet
144	printf '%s\n' \
145	  '{"type":"event","key":"a\nb","time":100,"value":2}' \
146	  '{"type":"event","key":"a\u000ab","time":200,"value":3}' \
147	  '{"type":"event","key":"a\\nb","time":300,"value":7}' \
148	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000}' \
149	  | /tmp/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000
150	echo "exit=$?"
151	```
152	
153	完整标准输出恰好为两行：
154	
155	```json
156	{"key":"a\nb","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":5}
157	{"key":"a\\nb","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":7}
158	```
159	
160	完整标准错误为空（零字节：没有迟到事件，也没有损坏记录）。程序自身退出码为 0：
161	
162	```
163	exit=0
164	```
165	
166	三条记录逐层对照（"输入字节"指 key 引号内程序实际读到的字节）：
167	
168	| 输入行 | 单引号内的写法 | key 引号内的输入字节 | JSON 解码后的 key | 归属 |
169	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
170	| 第 1 行 | `"a\nb"` | `a` `\` `n` `b` | `a`＋换行(0x0A)＋`b` | 换行 key |
171	| 第 2 行 | `"a\u000ab"` | `a` `\` `u` `0` `0` `0` `a` `b` | `a`＋换行(0x0A)＋`b` | 同一个换行 key |
172	| 第 3 行 | `"a\\nb"` | `a` `\` `\` `n` `b` | `a`＋反斜杠(0x5C)＋字母`n`＋`b` | 另一个 key |
173	
174	- 第 1 行的 `\n` 是 JSON 的换行短转义，解码成一个换行字符；第 2 行的 `\u000a` 是同一个换行字符的 Unicode 转义写法（码位 U+000A 即换行）。两者**解码结果逐字符相同**，所以是同一个 key，在 `[0,1000)` 内合并计数：`count=2`、`sum=2+3=5`。输入文本长短不同（`\n` 占两个字节、`\u000a` 占六个字节）不影响分组。
175	- 第 3 行的 `\\` 是 JSON 的反斜杠转义，只解码成**一个**反斜杠字符，其后的 `n` 是普通字母、不再参与任何转义，所以这个 key 在该位置是"反斜杠＋字母 n"两个字符。它**不会被再多解码一次**而变成换行 key，因此单独汇总：`count=1`、`sum=7`。
176	
177	### 结果为什么按这个次序输出
178	
179	同一条水位线一次关闭多个 key 的窗口时，先按窗口 end 升序、end 相同时再按**解码后的 key 的 UTF-8 字节顺序**排列。这个次序与输入记录的先后、与转义文本的长短都无关。本例两个窗口的 end 都是 1000，两个 key 的首字节同为 `a`，下一字节一个是换行 0x0A、一个是反斜杠 0x5C，而 `0x0A < 0x5C`，所以含换行的 key 排在前面。把三条事件任意调换先后顺序（例如先喂第 3 行、再喂第 1、2 行），输出的两行内容与次序完全不变。
180	
181	### 输出里换行仍以 JSON 转义呈现，每个窗口结果只占一个物理行
182	
183	结果 JSON 与输入遵循同一套转义：第一行结果 key 里的换行字符在输出上仍是两字符序列 `\n`（字节 0x5C 紧接 0x6E），不是原始字节 0x0A；第二行结果里那个真正的反斜杠转义成 `\\`，所以两行在纸面上绝不会看起来一样。整份标准输出只有两个换行字节，分别位于两行结果的末尾，**每个窗口结果恰好占一个物理输出行**，key 内部不含任何原始控制字节。
184	
185	再次读取该行 JSON 时，key 应还原出原来的字符，而真正的反斜杠不会被多解码一次。本机有 python3 时可用下面的命令复核（`repr` 会把真正的换行显示成 `\n`，把"反斜杠＋字母 n"显示成 `\\n`）：
186	
187	```bash
188	printf '%s\n' \
189	  '{"type":"event","key":"a\nb","time":100,"value":2}' \
190	  '{"type":"event","key":"a\u000ab","time":200,"value":3}' \
191	  '{"type":"event","key":"a\\nb","time":300,"value":7}' \
192	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000}' \
193	  | /tmp/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 \
194	  | python3 -c 'import sys,json
195	for line in sys.stdin:
196	    o=json.loads(line); print(repr(o["key"]), o["count"], o["sum"])'
197	```
198	
199	```text
200	'a\nb' 2 5
201	'a\\nb' 1 7
202	```
203	
204	即第一行的 key 里确实是一个换行字符，第二行确实是一个反斜杠加字母 n；后者没有被二次解码成换行，两行也没有合并。
205	
206	**复制命令时请保持单引号和反斜杠与上面逐字对应。** 本节用单引号包住每条记录，shell 不会改动其中的反斜杠。若把某条记录挪进双引号并按双引号习惯转义内部引号，shell 会先吃掉一层反斜杠：第三条若写成 `"{\"type\":\"event\",\"key\":\"a\\nb\",\"time\":300,\"value\":7}"`，程序收到的就变成 `a\nb`（真正的换行 key），三条事件会**静默合并成一行 `count=3、sum=12`**——这是另一份数据，而且不会报错。所以不要把记录挪进双引号，也不要自行增减反斜杠，以免复制后得到与文档不同的输入。
207	
208	### 失败示例：未配对的代理项是输入错误，不是普通迟到跳过
209	
210	下面是一个独立示例，共 4 行：先用一条事件和一条水位线正常关闭一个合法窗口；随后输入一条 key 含**未配对 Unicode 代理项**、且事件时间低于当前水位线的记录；最后再给一条水位线。
211	
212	```bash
213	go build -o /tmp/edgefleet ./cmd/edgefleet
214	printf '%s\n' \
215	  '{"type":"event","key":"ok","time":100,"value":5}' \
216	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000}' \
217	  '{"type":"event","key":"bad\ud800key","time":999,"value":1}' \
218	  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000}' \
219	  | /tmp/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000
220	echo "exit=$?"
221	```
222	
223	终端里标准输出（第 2 行水位线触发）先于标准错误（第 3 行记录触发）。分开列出：完整标准输出只有此前已关闭的那一个窗口，并且被原样保留：
224	
225	```json
226	{"key":"ok","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}
227	```
228	
229	完整标准错误恰好一行，指明出错的**物理行号**与字符损坏原因：
230	
231	```
232	aggregate: line 3: field "key" has an unpaired high surrogate in a Unicode escape
233	```
234	
235	程序自身退出码为 1：
236	
237	```
238	exit=1
239	```
240	
241	逐行说明（行号即物理输入行号）：
242	
243	- 第 1 行：合法事件，进入窗口 `[0,1000)`。
244	- 第 2 行：水位线 1000 关闭 `[0,1000)`，输出 `count=1、sum=5`，当前水位线变为 1000。
245	- 第 3 行：**物理第 3 行**即出错行。`\ud800` 落在高代理区间 U+D800–U+DBFF；按 JSON 规则，它后面必须紧跟另一个 `\uXXXX` 转义给出低代理项（U+DC00–U+DFFF），两个半区合起来才表示一个辅助平面字符。单独一个高代理项不对应任何 Unicode 字符，属于**字符编码损坏**。程序对 key 的解码是严格的：宁可失败也不把它替换成 U+FFFD 之类的替代字符——否则不同的损坏 key 可能彼此合并，还可能与真正是 U+FFFD 的 key 相撞。尽管这行的事件时间 999 也严格低于当前水位线 1000，**但 key 损坏检查先于迟到判断**，所以它是致命的输入错误（退出码 1），**而不是**普通迟到事件那种"在标准错误写一行迟到提示、跳过该事件、继续运行（退出码 0）"。对照可见：若只把这行的 key 换成合法的 `"ok"`、时间仍是 999，标准错误只会得到 `line 3: late event time=999 below current watermark 1000, skipped`，进程以 0 退出——两者是不同性质的处理。
246	- 第 4 行：致命错误之后停止读取后续记录，这条水位线 2000 不会再被处理，也**不会再产生任何输出**。标准输出停在第 2 行已写出的那一行，进程以退出码 1 失败退出。
247	
248	若改用 `go run ./cmd/edgefleet ...` 运行，`go run` 对非零退出统一报成退出码 1 并多打印一行 `exit status 1`；这里程序自身退出码本就是 1，构建二进制后即可直接观察到上面的结果。
249	
250	## 示例：累计求和的取值范围与即时溢出
251	
252	这一节专门说明同一个 key 在重叠窗口中的 `sum`：每条事件的值合法，并不等于把它加进每个窗口后的累计也合法。命令参数、逐行 JSON 输入格式、左闭右开的窗口划分和"只由水位线关闭、结束输入不补发"的规则都与前几节相同，这里只补充数值范围与失败时机。
253	
254	先分清两层合法性，它们在不同时机检查：
255	
256	- **每条 `value` 都合法**：事件的 `value` 字段本身必须能解析成一个有符号六十四位整数（`int64`），范围是 `[-9223372036854775808, 9223372036854775807]`。字段超出这个范围（例如 `9223372036854775808`）在解析这一物理行时就是记录错误，事件不会进入任何窗口，与下面的累计溢出是两类不同的失败。
257	- **每次累计也合法**：事件通过字段检查后，要把**完整的 value** 分别加进**每一个**包含其事件时间的窗口。各窗口的 `count`、`sum` 彼此独立记账：一条事件属于几个窗口，就在几个窗口里各计一次数、各加一次完整的 value，**不会**因为窗口重叠而把 value 按重叠数量分摊。某窗口本次加法的结果仍落在 `int64` 范围内才算合法。
258	
259	关于累计的判定时机与边界：
260	
261	- `value` 和窗口的 `sum` 都是有符号六十四位整数。检查发生在**每一次加法之前**，而不是等窗口关闭后才回头检查最终总和：某次加法恰好把累计带到上限 `9223372036854775807` 或下限 `-9223372036854775808` 仍然合法；一旦某次加法的结果越过任一端点，本次运行**立即**在这条事件上失败并停止读取后续记录，不会等到关闭窗口。
262	- 因为各窗口独立累计，**同一条自身合法的事件，可能在一个包含它的窗口里安全加入、在另一个包含它的窗口里造成溢出**；错误信息会点名实际越界的那一个窗口，而不是笼统归咎于这条事件碰到的所有重叠窗口。
263	- 负值可以抵消同一窗口里此前已接收的正值（总和随之回落）。但抵消只在事件被实际处理时生效：**致命错误之后才出现的抵消事件不会被读取，无法挽回这次运行**。
264	- 合法的大整数在结果 JSON 中始终是**精确的整数值**：直接写成十进制数字，不加引号变成字符串，也不经过浮点表示，因此不存在浮点舍入（大于 2 的 53 次方 `9007199254740992` 的整数照样原样输出）。
265	
266	### 成功示例：重叠窗口中的大整数与正负抵消
267	
268	窗口长度 1000、滑动间隔 600，窗口依次为 `[0,1000)`、`[600,1600)`、`[1200,2200)`、`[1800,2800)`……同一个 key `sensor-a`，共 6 行输入。第 1 行的值 `9007199254740993` 等于 2 的 53 次方加 1，是合法的 `int64`；第 4 行用负值 `-97` 抵消此前的正值。下面的命令可独立离线运行，并用构建出的二进制直接观察程序自身退出码：
269	
270	```bash
271	go build -o /tmp/edgefleet ./cmd/edgefleet
272	printf '%s\n' \
273	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":700,"value":9007199254740993}' \
274	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1000,"value":100}' \
275	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000}' \
276	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1300,"value":-97}' \

360	## 示例：事件时间合法，窗口结束时间仍可能越界
361	
362	上一节讲的是 `value` 累计求和越界；这一节讲另一类更容易误判的越界：**事件的 `time` 字段本身完全合法，但它所属的某个窗口的结束时间（`start + 窗口长度`）超出了有符号 64 位整数范围**，于是整条事件失败。本节统一使用窗口长度 7 毫秒（`--window-ms 7`）、滑动间隔 4 毫秒（`--slide-ms 4`），不启用分区，围绕单一 key `sensor-a`，记 `M = 9223372036854775807`（有符号六十四位整数上界）。窗口仍是左闭右开、起点从时间零开始按 4 递增（0、4、8……），只在靠近 M 的这一段讨论，先分清两层合法性：
363	
364	- **事件时间合法**：`time` 是不超过 M 的非负整数。M−5、M−4、M−3 这些时间字段本身都合法，解析这一物理行时不会有任何错误。
365	- **窗口结束时间可表示**：一条非迟到事件会计入**所有**包含其事件时间的窗口，每个窗口都要有 `end = start + 7`。只要其中**一个**窗口的 end 超过 M，这条事件就立即失败——哪怕它同时也属于另一个 end 仍可表示的窗口。这个检查在改动任何窗口计数之前完成，所以失败时该事件不会进入任何窗口。
366	
367	靠近上界的窗口排列（相邻起点相差 4，每个窗口长度 7）为：
368	
369	```
370	... [M−11,M−4)   [M−7,M)   [M−3,M+4) ...
371	```
372	
373	`[M−7,M)` 的结束时间恰好是 M，仍可表示；`[M−3,M+4)` 的结束时间是 M+4 = `9223372036854775811`，越过 M，无法用 `int64` 表示。

513	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":8}
514	{"key":"sensor-a","start":1000,"end":2000,"count":1,"sum":7}
515	{"key":"sensor-a","start":2000,"end":3000,"count":1,"sum":4}
516	```
517	
518	两个分区的事件合并进同一个窗口，输出只含 `key`、`start`、`end`、`count`、`sum`，不含分区字段，因此可以直接从输入算出每个结果。逐行说明（行号即物理输入行号）：
519	
520	- 第 1、2 行：两个分区各来一个事件，事件时间 100 和 200 都落在窗口 `[0,1000)` 内，合并累计 count=2、sum=5+3=8。此时没有任何输出——还没有水位线。
521	- 第 3 行：分区 0 的水位线推进到 1000，但分区 1 从未上报过水位线，整体水位线尚不存在（不是取已上报分区的值），所以窗口 `[0,1000)` 不关闭，没有新结果。这就是"等待"：一个分区已经推进，另一个分区尚未上报时，只能等后者表态，否则无法判断它是否还有更早的事件在路上。
522	- 第 4 行：分区 1 显式声明休眠。休眠分区退出整体水位线的最小值计算，剩下的活跃分区只有分区 0，整体水位线立即变为 1000，于是这条休眠记录本身就关闭了窗口 `[0,1000)`，输出第一行结果。可见休眠不是"丢弃"该分区：它已贡献的事件（第 2 行）照常计入，只是不再拖住其他分区。
523	- 第 5 行：事件落入窗口 `[1000,2000)`，无输出。
524	- 第 6 行：分区 0 水位线推进到 2000；分区 1 仍在休眠、不参与计算，整体水位线变为 2000，关闭 `[1000,2000)`，输出第二行结果（count=1、sum=7）。
525	- 第 7 行：分区 1 用水位线记录恢复。恢复水位线必须不低于该分区自己的旧水位线、也不低于当前整体水位线；这里 2000 恰好等于当前整体水位线 2000，取等成功。恢复后整体水位线为 min(2000, 2000) = 2000，没有新窗口可关——已关闭的窗口不会再次输出，所以这一行没有新结果。
526	- 第 8 行：分区 1 恢复后重新发送事件，落入窗口 `[2000,3000)`，无输出。
527	- 第 9 行：分区 0 水位线推进到 3000，但恢复后的分区 1 重新参与整体水位线的最小值计算，整体水位线为 min(3000, 2000) = 2000，窗口 `[2000,3000)` 不能关闭，没有新结果。
528	- 第 10 行：分区 1 水位线推进到 3000，整体水位线变为 3000，关闭 `[2000,3000)`，输出第三行结果（count=1、sum=4）。
529	- 第 11 行：事件落入窗口 `[3000,4000)`，此后输入结束。结束输入不会补发尚未关闭的窗口——窗口只由水位线（含休眠声明带来的水位线推进）关闭，所以该事件不产生任何输出。
530	
531	注意：休眠必须由输入用 `{"type":"idle","partition":N}` 显式声明，一段时间没有输入不会被当成自动休眠；休眠也不是无限水位线，不会丢弃该分区已有或待处理的事件。
532	
533	### 误用一：恢复水位线过低
534	
535	休眠分区的恢复水位线若低于当前整体水位线，或低于该分区自己休眠前的旧水位线，都会失败。例如整体水位线已到 2000 时用 1500 恢复：
536	
537	```bash
538	printf '%s\n' \
539	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5,"partition":0}' \
540	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000,"partition":0}' \
541	  '{"type":"idle","partition":1}' \
542	  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}' \
543	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1500,"partition":1}' \
544	  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
545	```
546	
547	标准输出保留失败前已关闭的窗口，标准错误报告物理行号和原因，退出码为 1：
548	
549	```
550	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
551	aggregate: line 5: resume watermark 1500 for partition 1 is below the current effective watermark 2000   # 标准错误
552	```
553	
554	若该分区休眠前已上报过更高的水位线，则报另一种原因，例如旧水位线为 2500 时用 2400 恢复：
555	
556	```
557	aggregate: line 4: resume watermark 2400 for partition 1 is below its previous watermark 2500
558	```
559	
560	### 误用二：休眠期间直接发送事件
561	
562	休眠分区只能用下一条水位线记录恢复，不能直接发事件。下面第 5 行的事件时间 500 虽然已经低于当前整体水位线 1000，但不会按普通迟到事件跳过并记一条迟到日志，而是致命错误（注意第 4 行是空行，空行也计入行号，所以出错的是第 5 行）：
563	
564	```bash
565	printf '%s\n' \
566	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5,"partition":0}' \
567	  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000,"partition":0}' \
568	  '{"type":"idle","partition":1}' \
569	  '' \
570	  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":500,"value":1,"partition":1}' \
571	  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}' \
572	  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
573	```
574	
575	```
576	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
577	aggregate: line 5: event for idle partition 1 is not allowed; send a watermark to resume it first   # 标准错误
578	```
579	
580	这两类失败都会报告物理输入行号和原因、停止处理后续记录（上例中第 6 行的水位线不会再被读取），退出码为 1，但此前已输出的窗口结果全部保留。
581	
582	## 示例：通过 Go 库接入输入流——正常结束与读取失败的区分
583	
584	前面的示例都通过 `edgefleet aggregate` 命令从标准输入读数据。把聚合功能嵌进自己的 Go 程序时，入口是库函数 `edgefleet.RunAggregate`（固定窗口；滑动、分区变体分别是 `RunAggregateSliding`、`RunAggregatePartitioned`、`RunAggregatePartitionedSliding`，读取边界规则完全相同）：
585	
586	```go
587	func RunAggregate(r io.Reader, windowMillis int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error
588	```
589	
590	`r` 是任意 `io.Reader`（网络连接、管道、消息队列客户端都可以），`out` 接收每行一个的窗口结果 JSON，`lateLog` 接收迟到事件提示，二者都可以直接给内存里的 `bytes.Buffer`，不涉及文件、网络和当前时间。本节示例代码位于 [`examples/aggregate-read/main.go`](examples/aggregate-read/main.go)，可在本机离线直接运行：
591	
592	```bash
593	go run ./examples/aggregate-read
594	```
595	
596	### 读取器同时交出字节和错误时，哪些生效、哪些舍弃
597	
598	记录边界是**换行符，不是 `Read` 调用的边界**：一次 `Read` 可以只来半条记录，也可以一次带回多条记录。因此当读取器在最后一批字节上同时返回 `n > 0` 和一个错误时，需要区分这批内容里的两部分：
599	
600	- **已经收到换行符的完整记录**（包括与错误同一次 `Read` 带回的完整记录）按顺序逐条生效：事件入窗、水位线推进并关闭窗口，已关闭窗口的结果行已经写入 `out` 就保留。
601	- **最后一个换行符之后的未结束尾部必须舍弃**：它既不是事件也不是水位线，不会入窗、不会关闭窗口、不会产生迟到提示，也**不会**被当成"某一行 JSON 不合法"报成记录错误。
602	- 之后把读取器自己的错误**原样**作为 `RunAggregate` 的返回值交还调用方（不包装、不替换），所以调用方可以用 `errors.Is` 识别输入源报告的真实原因。
603	
604	正常结束与读取故障的判定只有一条：
605	
606	| 读取器最后的返回 | 含义 | 无换行的最后一条记录 | `RunAggregate` 返回 |
607	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
608	| 裸 `io.EOF`（`err == io.EOF`） | 正常结束 | 仍作为最后一条完整记录处理 | `nil` |
609	| 任何其他错误（含**包装过的** `io.EOF`、错误链里能 `errors.Is` 到 `io.EOF` 的组合错误） | 读取故障 | 舍弃，不生效 | 读取器的原始错误，原样返回 |
610	
611	注意：判定正常结束只能用错误身份比较（在读取器实现里即 `return io.EOF`），**不能用 `errors.Is(err, io.EOF)`**。`fmt.Errorf("...: %w", io.EOF)` 包装出来的 EOF、或同时挂着 `io.EOF` 和真实故障原因的组合错误，即使 `errors.Is` 能找到 `io.EOF`，也一律按读取故障处理。
612	
613	### 同一份输入的两种结束方式
614	
615	示例围绕同一份字节流对比（1000 毫秒固定窗口，同一个 key `sensor-a`，共 4 个物理行，**最后一行故意不带换行符**）：
616	
617	```text
618	line 1: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5}      + "\n"
619	line 2: {"type":"watermark","time":1000}                            + "\n"
620	line 3: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1100,"value":7}    + "\n"
621	line 4: {"type":"watermark","time":2000}                            (无换行)
622	```
623	
624	- 第 1 行事件时间 100，落在窗口 **`[0,1000)`**（左闭右开）内。
625	- 第 2 行水位线 1000（有换行），关闭 end ≤ 1000 的窗口，即 `[0,1000)`。
626	- 第 3 行事件时间 1100，落在窗口 **`[1000,2000)`** 内。
627	- 第 4 行水位线 2000（无换行）：只有正常结束时它才是一条记录，用来关闭 `[1000,2000)`；读取故障时它只是未结束尾部。
628	
629	读取器的关键实现就是"最后一批字节和结束原因同一次返回"——真实连接正是这样把缓冲区残留字节和故障一起交出来的：
630	
631	```go
632	func (r *endWithReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
633		if r.pos >= len(r.data) {
634			if r.end != nil {
635				return 0, r.end // end 为 nil 时下面返回裸 io.EOF
636			}
637			return 0, io.EOF
638		}
639		n := copy(p, r.data[r.pos:])
640		r.pos += n
641		if r.pos < len(r.data) {
642			return n, nil
643		}
644		if r.end != nil {
645			return n, r.end // 最后一批字节与故障同一次 Read 返回
646		}
647		return n, io.EOF     // 最后一批字节与裸 io.EOF 同一次 Read 返回
648	}
649	```
650	
651	**方式一：正常结束（读取器返回裸 `io.EOF`）。** 无换行的最后一条水位线仍按完整的最后一条记录处理，两个窗口都关闭：
652	
653	- `out`（窗口结果，恰好两行；区间即各自行的 `start`/`end`）：
654	
655	```json
656	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}
657	{"key":"sensor-a","start":1000,"end":2000,"count":1,"sum":7}
658	```
659	
660	- `lateLog`（迟到提示）：为空——本例没有严格低于当前水位线的事件。
661	- 返回错误：`nil`。`RunAggregate` 在正常结束时消费掉裸 `io.EOF`，调用方按通常的 `err == nil` 判断成功即可，不会收到 `io.EOF`。
662	
663	**方式二：输入源在交付最后一批字节时报告读取故障。** 第 1～3 行的换行都已收到，全部生效；第 4 行水位线没有换行，属于未结束尾部，直接舍弃，不推进水位线。因此：
664	
665	- `out`：只有第一个窗口一行，第二个窗口**不会因为调用返回了错误就补发**——窗口只由已生效的水位线关闭，结束（无论正常还是故障）都不补发未关闭窗口：
666	
667	```json
668	{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}
669	```
670	
671	- `lateLog`：为空（被舍弃的尾部既不是事件也不是水位线，不产生任何迟到提示）。
672	- 返回错误：输入源自己的错误原样返回，示例里是 `upstream connection reset by peer`；`errors.Is(err, errUpstream)` 为 `true`，而 `errors.As(err, *edgefleet.InputError)` 为 `false`——调用方据此知道这是**输入源的读取故障**，不能把它误报成"第 4 行 JSON 不合法"。第 4 行的 JSON 恰好是完整的也一样：没收到换行，它就不是记录。
673	
674	**方式三：包装过的 `io.EOF` 仍然是读取故障。** 把上面的故障换成 `fmt.Errorf("gateway closed while delivering the last batch: %w", io.EOF)` 再跑一次：`errors.Is(err, io.EOF)` 虽然为 `true`，但它不是裸 `io.EOF`，输出与方式二完全相同——只有 `[0,1000)` 一行，返回错误为 `gateway closed while delivering the last batch: EOF`。自己实现 `io.Reader` 时，正常结束必须 `return io.EOF` 本身，不要返回它的包装副本。
675	
676	### 故障同批交付的完整记录本身有格式错误时，记录错误优先
677	
678	如果故障那批字节里、换行之前的某条完整记录本身格式就不对，则**优先返回该记录的错误**，而不是后知道的读取错误；定位按物理行号，**空行也占行号**，出错记录之后的记录和未结束尾部都不再处理。示例第 4 个场景使用如下输入（注意第 2 行是空行）：
679	
680	```text
681	line 1: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5}   + "\n"
682	line 2:                                                           + "\n"   （空行）
683	line 3: not-json                                                  + "\n"   （完整但格式错误）
684	line 4: {"type":"watermark","time":1000}                          (无换行，未结束尾部)
685	```
686	
687	读取器同样在最后一批字节上返回故障，但：
688	
689	- 返回错误是 `line 3: invalid JSON record: invalid character 'o' in literal null (expecting 'u')`，可通过 `errors.As(err, *edgefleet.InputError)` 取到结构化的 `Line=3` 和 `Reason`；它**覆盖**了之后才获知的读取错误（此时 `errors.Is(err, errUpstream)` 为 `false`）。
690	- 第 3 行之前没有任何窗口被关闭，所以 `out` 为空；`lateLog` 也为空。第 4 行尾部和读取故障都不会再被处理或上报。
691	
692	输出写出侧的失败规则与读取侧对称：窗口结果或迟到提示未能完整写出时，返回 `*edgefleet.OutputError`（可 `errors.Is` 到写出器自己的错误），触发它的物理行号、结果类别、key 与窗口区间或迟到事件时间都会标明，已写出的字节保留。特别注意：写出器**收下整条结果（JSON 加换行）之后仍返回自己的错误时，调用依然失败**——完整字节数不能抵消错误。完整规则、可运行示例与逐场景输出见下一节《示例：通过 Go 库接入输出流——窗口结果写出失败如何判定》。
693	
694	以上规则均为现有产品行为，`edgefleet aggregate` 命令的用法、输入格式以及"输入结束时不补发未关闭窗口"的规则保持不变；库入口只是让调用方能够直接提供自己的 `io.Reader`/`io.Writer`，并按错误身份区分读取结束原因与写出失败原因。
695	
696	## 示例：通过 Go 库接入输出流——窗口结果写出失败如何判定
697	
698	上一节解决"输入是怎么结束的"，这一节解决**结果有没有真正送出去**。库入口仍然是 `edgefleet.RunAggregate`（滑动、分区变体同理）：
699	
700	```go
701	func RunAggregate(r io.Reader, windowMillis int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error
702	```
703	
704	`out`、`lateLog` 都是普通 `io.Writer`：真实接入时它们可能是网络连接、管道或日志管线客户端，对端可能在收下部分甚至全部字节后仍然报错。示例代码位于 [`examples/aggregate-write/main.go`](examples/aggregate-write/main.go)，输入用内存里的 `strings.Reader`、输出用内存里的自写 `io.Writer`，不涉及文件、网络与当前时间，可离线直接运行：
705	
706	```bash
707	go run ./examples/aggregate-write
708	```
709	
710	### 一条结果怎样才算"写出了"
711	
712	每条输出都必须在**一次 `Write` 调用中完整落地**：窗口结果是"完整 JSON 对象 **加行尾换行**"（`{"key":...}\n`），迟到提示是完整一行。判定只有两条：
713	
714	| `Write(p)` 的返回 | 含义 | `RunAggregate` 返回 |
715	| --- | --- | --- |
716	| `n == len(p)` 且 `err == nil` | 完整写出 | 继续处理 |
717	| `err != nil`（无论 `n` 是 0、部分还是 **`len(p)`**） | 写出端自己的故障 | `*edgefleet.OutputError`，其 `Err` 为写出器返回的**原始错误** |
718	| `err == nil` 但 `n < len(p)` | 内容没写全 | `*edgefleet.OutputError`，其 `Err` 为 `io.ErrShortWrite` |
719	
720	两个容易踩空的点：
721	
722	- **收下整条 JSON 和换行、同时返回自己的错误，仍然是写出失败。** 完整字节数不能抵消错误——字节已经到了对端的缓冲区，不等于对端承认了这次投递；调用方必须按返回错误处理，不能因为"行看起来完整"就当成功。
723	- **只收部分字节却返回 `nil`，报 `io.ErrShortWrite`。** 这是 `io.Writer` 契约里的短写：没有错误身份可以挂，库统一补上 `io.ErrShortWrite`，调用方用 `errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite)` 识别。
724	- 两种情况可以叠加区分：收了**部分**字节、又返回**自己的错误**时，保留的是那个原始错误（`errors.Is` 能到它），而不是 `io.ErrShortWrite`——短写哨兵只在写出器返回空错误时使用。
725	
726	失败统一包成 `*edgefleet.OutputError`，用 `errors.As` 取出：
727	
728	| 字段 | 含义 |
729	| --- | --- |
730	| `Line` | 触发这批输出的**物理输入行号**（空行也占行号） |
731	| `Kind` | 结果类别：`"window result"`（窗口结果）或 `"late-event notice"`（迟到提示） |
732	| `Detail` | 窗口结果给出 `key "k" window [start,end)`；迟到提示给出迟到事件时间与判定所用水位线 |
733	| `Err` | 写出端的错误：写出器自己的错误（原样保留），或 `io.ErrShortWrite`；`errors.Is` 经 `Unwrap` 生效 |
734	
735	错误字符串形如：
736	
737	```text
738	line 6: window result not fully written (key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)): result sink connection broken
739	```
740	
741	### 失败之后：保留什么、不做什么
742	
743	一次写出失败立即终止本次运行，规则与读取失败对称：
744	
745	- 写出器**已经收下的字节原样保留**：此前完整写出（含换行）的结果行仍是有效窗口结果；失败那一次 `Write` 收下的字节——哪怕恰好是一整行——只是**物理残留，不是被承认的窗口结果**，调用方要靠 `*OutputError` 而不是靠"缓冲里有没有这行"来判定。
746	- 引擎**不会重发或重试**失败内容（不会补写缺失尾部），**不会继续输出同一水位线本批剩余的窗口**，也**不再读取或处理后续任何记录**；输入结束（无论正常 EOF 还是读取故障）**不会补发**仍未关闭的窗口。
747	- 迟到提示写出失败时规则相同，只是 `Kind` 为 `"late-event notice"`、`Detail` 标明迟到事件时间和水位线。
748	
749	### 同一份输入：一条水位线关闭三个窗口
750	
751	示例四个场景共用同一份逐行 JSON 输入（1000 毫秒固定窗口，单个 key `sensor-a`，共 **7 个物理行**；**第 3 行是空行**，空行被忽略但照占行号，所以触发写出的水位线在第 6 行；第 7 行无尾换行）：
752	
753	```text
754	line 1: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":1}    + "\n"
755	line 2: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":150,"value":2}    + "\n"
756	line 3: (blank line)                                              + "\n"
757	line 4: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1100,"value":3}   + "\n"
758	line 5: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":2100,"value":4}   + "\n"
759	line 6: {"type":"watermark","time":3000}                          + "\n"
760	line 7: {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":3100,"value":5}   (no newline)
761	```
762	
763	窗口参数是 `RunAggregate(r, 1000, out, lateLog)`。第 1、2 行事件落在 `[0,1000)`（count=2、sum=3），第 4 行落在 `[1000,2000)`（count=1、sum=3），第 5 行落在 `[2000,3000)`（count=1、sum=4）。**第 6 行水位线 3000 在一次处理中按 end 升序连续关闭三个窗口**，每个窗口对应一次 `Write`：
764	
765	```text
766	[0,1000)  ->  第 1 次 Write（成功后即被承认）
767	[1000,2000)  ->  第 2 次 Write（示例在这一次制造失败）
768	[2000,3000)  ->  第 3 次 Write（失败后不再发生）
769	```
770	
771	第 7 行事件属于 `[3000,4000)`，之后再无水位线；即使在成功场景里，输入结束也不会补发它。示例的故障写出器只在**第 2 次 `Write`**（中间窗口 `[1000,2000)`）上按脚本行动，于是同一份输入就能对照"前面的结果成功写出、中间一条写出出问题、后面还有本可输出的窗口"。
772	
773	### 场景一（对照）：写出端正常，三个窗口全部输出
774	
775	`out` 是健康的缓冲写出器。返回错误为 `nil`，接收端恰好三行完整结果（每行都带换行），无残留片段，`lateLog` 为空：
776	
777	```text
778	=== 1. control: a healthy bytes.Buffer writer ===
779	result lines fully written by EARLIER, successful calls (valid window results):
780	  {"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":3}
781	  {"key":"sensor-a","start":1000,"end":2000,"count":1,"sum":3}
782	  {"key":"sensor-a","start":2000,"end":3000,"count":1,"sum":4}
783	bytes the failing call itself left behind: (none — no call failed)
784	late-event notice stream (lateLog): (none)
785	returned error: <nil>
786	  err == nil -> run succeeded; every window the watermark closed was written
787	```
788	
789	### 场景二：整条 JSON 与换行都已收下，写出器同时返回自己的错误
790	
791	第 2 次 `Write` 收下全部 61 个字节（`{"key":...,"sum":3}\n`，长度恰好等于提交长度）却返回 `result sink connection broken`。调用仍然失败：错误是 `*edgefleet.OutputError`，`Err` 为写出器原始错误，`errors.Is(err, errSinkBroken)` 为 `true`，而 `errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite)` 为 `false`。接收端的字节分成两部分呈现——**此前成功调用写出的 `[0,1000)` 一行是有效结果；失败那一次留下的一整行物理上存在，但不被承认**，不能当成 `[1000,2000)` 的窗口结果处理：
792	
793	```text
794	=== 2. failing call offers/keeps the whole line (JSON + newline) and returns its own error ===
795	result lines fully written by EARLIER, successful calls (valid window results):
796	  {"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":3}
797	bytes the failing call itself left behind: "{\"key\":\"sensor-a\",\"start\":1000,\"end\":2000,\"count\":1,\"sum\":3}\n" (61 of 61 bytes offered) — the WHOLE result line including its newline is physically present, but the Write returned an error: it is retained yet NOT an acknowledged window result
798	late-event notice stream (lateLog): (none)
799	returned error: line 6: window result not fully written (key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)): result sink connection broken
800	  errors.As(*edgefleet.OutputError) -> true
801	    triggering input line  : 6 (the blank physical line 3 kept its line number)
802	    result category (Kind) : "window result"
803	    record detail          : key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)
804	    writer error (Err)     : result sink connection broken
805	  errors.Is(err, errSinkBroken)  -> true (the writer's own error exposed through Unwrap)
806	  errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite) -> false
807	```
808	
809	### 场景三：只收下 12 个字节的前缀，却返回空错误
810	
811	第 2 次 `Write` 只保留前缀 `{"key":"sens`（61 字节中的 12 个）并返回 `nil`。这是短写：`Err` 为 `io.ErrShortWrite`，`errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite)` 为 `true`。接收端在第一个完整行之后是一个**残留片段**，它不是合法 JSON、更不是窗口结果；同批第三个窗口 `[2000,3000)` 不会再写出：
812	
813	```text
814	=== 3. failing call keeps only a 12-byte prefix and returns nil ===
815	result lines fully written by EARLIER, successful calls (valid window results):
816	  {"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":3}
817	bytes the failing call itself left behind: "{\"key\":\"sens" (12 of 61 bytes offered) — a residual fragment, NOT a valid window result
818	late-event notice stream (lateLog): (none)
819	returned error: line 6: window result not fully written (key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)): short write
820	  errors.As(*edgefleet.OutputError) -> true
821	    triggering input line  : 6 (the blank physical line 3 kept its line number)
822	    result category (Kind) : "window result"
823	    record detail          : key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)
824	    writer error (Err)     : short write
825	  errors.Is(err, errSinkBroken)  -> false (the writer's own error exposed through Unwrap)
826	  errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite) -> true
827	```
828	
829	### 场景四：收下部分前缀，同时返回自己的错误
830	
831	第 2 次 `Write` 同样只保留 12 字节前缀，但这次返回 `result sink connection broken`。保留的是**写出器的原始错误**而不是短写哨兵：`errors.Is(err, errSinkBroken)` 为 `true`、`errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite)` 为 `false`。接收端内容与场景三相同（一个完整行加一个残留片段），区别只在错误身份——这正是调用方区分"对端明确报错"与"对端违约式短写"的依据：
832	
833	```text
834	=== 4. failing call keeps only a 12-byte prefix and returns its own error ===
835	result lines fully written by EARLIER, successful calls (valid window results):
836	  {"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":3}
837	bytes the failing call itself left behind: "{\"key\":\"sens" (12 of 61 bytes offered) — a residual fragment, NOT a valid window result
838	late-event notice stream (lateLog): (none)
839	returned error: line 6: window result not fully written (key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)): result sink connection broken
840	  errors.As(*edgefleet.OutputError) -> true
841	    triggering input line  : 6 (the blank physical line 3 kept its line number)
842	    result category (Kind) : "window result"
843	    record detail          : key "sensor-a" window [1000,2000)
844	    writer error (Err)     : result sink connection broken
845	  errors.Is(err, errSinkBroken)  -> true (the writer's own error exposed through Unwrap)
846	  errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite) -> false
847	```
848	
849	### 把接收内容对应回水位线
850	
851	三个失败场景的接收端可以直接对照第 6 行水位线本应关闭的三个窗口：
852	
853	| 窗口 | 触发它的水位线 | 三个失败场景里的结局 |
854	| --- | --- | --- |
855	| `[0,1000)` | 第 6 行（本批第 1 次写出，先于故障） | **完整保留**，是唯一被承认的窗口结果行 |
856	| `[1000,2000)` | 第 6 行（本批第 2 次写出，即故障点） | 未被承认：场景二物理上留有一整行，场景三/四留有 12 字节片段；**均不是有效结果**，引擎不重发 |
857	| `[2000,3000)` | 第 6 行（本批第 3 次写出） | **完全没有输出**：故障后同批剩余窗口不再写出 |
858	| `[3000,4000)` | 本应由更晚的水位线关闭 | 第 7 行事件在故障后不再被读取；即使读到，输入结束也不补发未关闭窗口 |
859	
860	接入方据此即可判定一次调用：`err == nil` 且收到的完整行覆盖本批全部窗口才算成功；拿到 `*edgefleet.OutputError` 时，用 `Line`/`Kind`/`Detail` 定位是哪条输入触发的哪个窗口结果，用 `errors.Is` 在写出端原始错误与 `io.ErrShortWrite` 之间区分原因，再按"完整行保留、残留丢弃、后续窗口缺失"来处理下游一致性。窗口结果与迟到提示的写出规则、错误类型在四个库入口（`RunAggregate`、`RunAggregateSliding`、`RunAggregatePartitioned`、`RunAggregatePartitionedSliding`）上完全一致。
861	
862	## 技术方向
863	
864	validator, node-monitoring, device-fleet, p2p-network, telemetry, devnet
865	
866	## 运行要求
867	
868	Go 1.26，仅使用标准库，全部行为可在本机 CPU 上离线复现。
869
